page_data_script:
route = f"/shop/{frappe.form_dict.get('route')}"
item = frappe.call('invento_webshop.api.item.get_item_details_by_route', route=route)

data.user = frappe.session.user
data.category_route = f"/shop?category_name={item.item_group}"
data.item = item
data.reviews = item.reviews
data.related_items = item.related_items
data.metatags = {
    "og:type": "product",
    'title': item.item_name,
    'image': item.image,
    'description': item.description
}
data.page_data = {
  'csrf_token': frappe.session.csrf_token 
}
